mechanism: Both agents can reduce renal function; torsemide may decrease amoxicillin clearance while amoxicillin may cause acute interstitial nephritis, potentiating loop diuretic-induced renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function and serum creatinine; ensure adequate hydration; assess for signs of reduced amoxicillin efficacy or accumulation; consider alternative antibiotics if significant renal decline occurs.
